entities.name: Logan
entities.description: Keeper of Inys Haen, sixth in the line of Haen the First, a very old man who gave his Keeper's Memories to his daughter and died in the raiders' fire.

entities.name: Haen the First
entities.description: Logan's ancestor, first of the Keepers, whose Seeing was more powerful.

entities.name: Aylith
entities.description: Logan's daughter, to whom he passed his Keeper's Memories.

entities.name: Selka
entities.description: Daughter Logan fathered at nearly age 80.

entities.name: Inys Nohr
entities.description: Place from which raiders attacked Inys Haen.

entities.name: The Parting
entities.description: Event that damaged the Clan Tree of Cridhe; years are counted from it.

entities.name: Clan Tree of Cridhe
entities.description: Tree severely damaged during the Parting.

events.summary: In year 520 of the Parting Logan performs part of the spring ritual before raiders from Inys Nohr attack.
events.quote: the elderly Logan performed part of the spring ritual before being attacked by raiders from Inys Nohr

events.summary: Logan bestows his Keeper's Memories on Aylith and throws her clear of the fire before being consumed by it.
events.quote: He managed to bestow his Keeper's Memories to his daughter Aylith and throw her clear of the fire

relations.quote: sixth in the line of his ancestor Haen the First
Logan was the Keeper of Inys Haen
